bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Support for Small Business and Charities and Other Measures) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2023-11-27.41.1) introduced by Barker MP [Tony Pasin](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/barker/tony_pasin) (Liberal), which means they failed. ### What do the amendments do?
